http_request_transform.expression: http.host eq "selarasui.my.id" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and lower(trim(http.request.headers["accept"][0])) eq "text/markdown" and http.request.uri.path eq "/"

http.host eq "selarasui.my.id" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and lower(trim(http.request.headers["accept"][0])) eq "text/markdown" and (not (http.request.uri.path contains ".") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/overview/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/components/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/composites/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/blocks/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/utilities/")))

http_request_cache_settings.description: Bypass cache for Selaras Markdown requests
http_request_cache_settings.expression: http.host eq "selarasui.my.id" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and lower(trim(http.request.headers["accept"][0])) eq "text/markdown" and (raw.http.request.uri.path eq "/" or (not (raw.http.request.uri.path contains ".") and (starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/overview/") or starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/components/") or starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/composites/") or starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/blocks/") or starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/utilities/"))) or (starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/raw/") and ends_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, ".md")))

http_response_headers_transform.expression: http.host eq "selarasui.my.id" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (raw.http.request.uri.path eq "/" or (not (raw.http.request.uri.path contains ".") and (starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/overview/") or starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/components/") or starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/composites/") or starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/blocks/") or starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/utilities/"))) or (starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/raw/") and ends_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, ".md")))

http.host eq "selarasui.my.id" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and lower(trim(http.request.headers["accept"][0])) eq "text/markdown" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/raw/") and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".md")) and http.response.code eq 200 and http.response.content_type.media_type in {"text/markdown" "text/plain"}
